HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT BANSAL  OR % 17.11.2023 1.

The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No.65/2017 under Sections 420/468/471/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) registered at Police Station New Friends Colony and the consequential proceedings emanating therefrom on the ground of settlement.
2. The petitioners and respondents no.2 and 3 were business partners and respondent no.4 is a Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) firm which is represented by the respondent no.2.
A dispute arose between the parties which resulted in filing of the FIR by the respondent no.2 against the petitioners.

sentences.text:
The parties have settled all their disputes and claims against each other in terms of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) dated 2nd February, 2023, which is filed as Annexure B.
4. Issue Notice.

5. Notice is accepted by the learned Standing counsel appearing on behalf of the State and the counsel appearing on behalf of the respondents no.2 and 3.
6. Learned Standing counsel appearing on behalf of the State submits that the FIR is still at an investigating stage.
7. The respondents no.2 and 3 are present in Court and have been identified by their counsel and by the IO.
They inform the Court that they have settled the matter of their own free will and without any coercion.
They further state that they do not wish to pursue the present FIR any further and have no objection if the present petition is allowed.
8. The petitioners are present in Court and have been identified by their counsel and the Investigating Officer (IO).
They affirm the statement of the respondents no.2 and 3 and undertake to abide by the terms of settlement arrived at between the parties.

9. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Hence, it would be in the interest of justice to quash the aforementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
10. Consequently, the FIR No.65/2017 registered at Police Station New Friends Colony, Delhi and proceedings pursuant thereto are quashed.
